title: AI & Machine Learning
description: Comprehensive roadmap to become an AI & ML Engineer: Mathematics, Supervised/Unsupervised Learning, Deep Neural Networks, GenAI, and MLOps.

nodes.title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
nodes.description: Linear algebra, matrix operations, multivariate calculus, probability distributions, and optimization algorithms.

children.title: Linear Algebra & Matrix Decompositions
children.description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, SVD, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

children.title: Calculus & Gradient Descent
children.description: Partial derivatives, chain rule, Jacobians, Hessians, stochastic gradient descent (SGD), and Adam.

children.title: Probability & Statistics
children.description: Probability distributions, Bayes' Theorem, Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), hypothesis testing.

nodes.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
nodes.description: Supervised, unsupervised, ensemble learning algorithms, feature engineering, and cross-validation.

children.title: Regression & Classification Algorithms
children.description: Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, SVM, k-Nearest Neighbors, Naive Bayes.

children.title: Ensemble Methods (Random Forest, XGBoost)
children.description: Bagging vs Boosting, Random Forest, AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, LightGBM.

children.title: Unsupervised Learning & Clustering
children.description: K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, DBSCAN, t-SNE, UMAP dimensional reduction.

nodes.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
nodes.description: Perceptrons, backpropagation, PyTorch/TensorFlow, CNNs for Vision, and RNNs/Transformers for Sequential Data.

children.title: Feedforward Neural Networks & Backpropagation
children.description: Activation functions (ReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax), cross-entropy loss, backpropagation chain rule.

children.title: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
children.description: Convolution filters, pooling layers, ResNet architectures, transfer learning for image tasks.

children.title: Transformers & Self-Attention Mechanics
children.description: Self-attention mechanism, Multi-Head Attention, Positional Encoding, Encoder-Decoder architectures.

nodes.title: Generative AI, LLMs & RAG
nodes.description: Large Language Models, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and LangChain/LlamaIndex.

children.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
children.description: Chunking strategies, embedding models, vector search (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma), hybrid retrieval.

children.title: AI Agents & Tool Use
children.description: ReAct framework, autonomous agent loops, multi-agent orchestrations with AutoGen/CrewAI.
